mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, release_id, approval_status, requested_by, requested_at, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, review_comment, expired_at, created_at, updated_at FROM batch.config_approval WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND release_id = #{releaseId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, tenant_id, release_id, approval_status, requested_by, requested_at, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, review_comment, expired_at, created_at, updated_at FROM batch.config_approval WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO batch.config_approval ( tenant_id, release_id, approval_status, requested_by, review_comment, expired_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{param.tenantId}, #{param.releaseId}, #{param.approvalStatus}, #{param.requestedBy}, #{param.reviewComment}, #{param.expiredAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
